items.title: Keep cash at $0; do not list from this worker
items.detail: The local package builds and validates at $0. The operator may separately submit as Free; no payout setup is required for Free. No upload or publication occurs from these tools.

items.title: Treat www.agensi.dev and www.agensi.io as different hosts
items.detail: A1: entire www.agensi.dev host (including /sell) 302s unauthenticated clients to Cloudflare Access. The currently verifiable seller contract is on www.agensi.io (no Access wall). Apex agensi.dev was Cloudflare 522.

items.title: No public seller listing API or npm SDK
items.detail: A1 found no public seller create API, OpenAPI, or official seller SDK. POST /api/skills is HTML 404. Entry is UI handoff only (/dashboard/submit on agensi.io). Buyer MCP at https://mcp.agensi.io/mcp is not a seller upload API.

items.title: Official Agensi hosts are www.agensi.io (auth/sell) and mcp.agensi.io
items.detail: Official seller entry is www.agensi.io/auth and /sell. Buyer MCP is https://mcp.agensi.io/mcp (initialize unauthenticated; never get_skill confirm=true). www.agensi.dev Cloudflare Access is an unrelated tenant, not a seller path; do not enter from this worker.

items.title: Root agensi.io creator session (official seller entry; not www.agensi.dev Access)
items.detail: Use the existing creator session at https://www.agensi.io/dashboard/submit. No new account or credential discovery is needed.

items.title: Enable Stripe Connect and/or Zoneless USDC-on-Solana before paid publish
items.detail: ToS §6.1 (last updated 2026-09-02): paid skill publish is blocked until a payout method is set up and enabled. Rails named in ToS: Stripe Connect or Zoneless USDC on Solana. Account-level eligibility is not verifiable without auth. Do not assume this worker is eligible.

items.title: Paid price at least $5.00, or list free
items.detail: ToS: minimum price for paid skills is $5.00. Creator share 70% of net ex-VAT; platform 30% all-in. Free listings are allowed and do not cost credits. This draft is not published at either price.

items.title: Build ZIP locally; operator submits Free
items.detail: Run npm run build:zip. Upload the ZIP containing one skill folder with SKILL.md, at most 50 MB. Name at most 60 characters. Supply the full real prompt and output from DEMO.md. Submission/review remains an operator action.

items.title: Cite the public pin; do not claim proprietary ownership of free recipes
items.detail: PROVENANCE.md attributes the separate public source pin. The helper and fixtures are original; no upstream recipes are redistributed or sold as proprietary.

items.title: Expect the 8-point automated scan plus human review
items.detail: Public copy: automated 8-point scan, then AI + human review, usually 24–48 hours. MCP discoverable toggle defaults on.

items.title: Disclose offline filesystem-only behavior
items.detail: This shipped skill only reads explicitly supplied local directories. It makes no network calls and does not execute their contents. Referenced upstream gateway recipes are not bundled.

items.title: Warrant distribution rights; keep listing copy accurate
items.detail: Confirm distribution rights and accurate copy before submission. Free price does not confer rights to someone else's recipe.

items.title: Keep private account IDs out of this public overlay
items.detail: Cloudflare session cookies, GitHub OAuth tokens, Stripe account IDs, bank last-fours, and Solana payout wallets must not be added to these files. Access handoff records the steps, not the secrets.
